name: Membership and Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity
definition: The **Membership and Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity** of $\mathcal{H}$ is the minimum worst-case number of queries needed to identify an unknown target in $\mathcal{H}$ when the learner may use membership queries and equivalence queries whose proposed hypotheses belong to $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Minimum worst-case number of membership or proper equivalence queries needed to identify the target.
origin_references: Membership and equivalence queries in the exact query-learning model are introduced in \cite{angluin1988queries}; this parameter restricts equivalence hypotheses to $\mathcal{H}$.
